turns.text: I keep thinking about why I enjoy talking with Mara: she notices tiny details, makes me laugh, and somehow long walks never feel long.
Anyway, should we print the receipt in color or black and white?
The receipt can wait—I would rather stay with what I was saying about Mara. What else might explain why those conversations feel so easy?
